originalOutcome: Original Launch pointer click and successful model preflight, then generic capture-result-unknown; business Review not entered. The private inner rejection cause was not logged.
exactSourceFault: isUnstartedCaptureEditable always excluded an original seed without team.capture. Model reads and probe used retained seed source, while runtime capture selected the current published source. A newly published same-provider TEST source therefore could not receive the source-bound probe required for the prospective capture.
proofBoundary: Actual captured profile projection matches the original saved seed probe and differs from published global/project candidates. This does not prove that original runtime capture reached that exact private validation branch, nor reconstruct publication ordering not present in the receipt.
change: Allow only a true original seed with absent capture/configurationRevision/launchId through the existing never-started, current-roster and all-retained-launch released-custody checks. A failed or unavailable seed check preserves its existing retained model read and refuses prospective evidence; complete-capture errors still propagate.
preservedBoundaries: No runtime allocation during model preflight
No profile, team or launch publication writes
Source updates invalidate old prospective probes
Original launch.read is inside the seed fallback boundary
notClaimed: Actual native process or paid provider acceptance
Source refresh authorization after runtime admission
